characters.parts_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D cutout animation artwork, reference-preserving sprite parts atlas.
Image 1 is the approved character identity reference, not a layout to reproduce. Species: lemon-yellow baby cockatiel, warm ivory belly, round orange cheeks, gray hooked beak, gray scaly feet. Preserve soft detailed matte feather shading and the very distinctive long swept yellow crest. The crest is a separate part in the last cell; do not include it on the head.
Create ONE clean, high-resolution, genuinely transparent landscape-or-square 3 by 3 regular-grid atlas: exactly THREE equal columns and THREE equal rows. Each cell has exactly the one detached animation part listed below, generous empty transparent padding on every side. Invisible grid, no lines or labels.
Row 1 left: ONLY the complete detached round head, with the exact same beautiful original face, eyes and curved beak, relaxed eyes fully open, beak closed in a gentle expression; near frontal three-quarter view like reference, head upright. Head includes cheeks and full cranium but NO neck, torso, wings, feet, or separated crest/tuft.
Row 1 middle: ONLY a plump pear-shaped torso with short rounded neck connection, no head, no wings, no tail, no feet. Restore the body's feather texture completely behind where the wings would normally cover it.
Row 1 right: ONLY one folded front wing pointing downward, shoulder at top, rounded feather tips at bottom.
Row 2 left: ONLY the same front wing half unfolded, shoulder at top, slightly fanned feathers pointing downward and out.
Row 2 middle: ONLY the same front wing fully unfurled with a lovely broad fan of flight feathers; shoulder at upper left, wing extends outward to the right, as a flying wing, no body.
Row 2 right: ONLY a compact tail fan, base at top and feather tips below, same species and shading.
Row 3 left: ONLY one little left foot with all toes, leg connection at top.
Row 3 middle: ONLY one little right foot with all toes, leg connection at top.
Row 3 right: ONLY the separated head crest/tuft in exactly the reference's shape and color, base at bottom. For the lovebird with no crest leave this cell transparent.
Invariants: preserve original style, color palette, feather texture, softness, eye highlights, beak anatomy and cute proportions. The head is the most important part: it must look like the SAME character in image 1. Avoid a generic owl-like face or clay redesign. All parts use the same near-front camera and original consistent light, with natural overlapping connection margins for rigging. Fit every part fully inside its own cell, no cropped edges or overlap across cells. Alpha transparent everywhere outside the parts. No background, floor shadow, text, captions, cell lines, numbers, logos, extra parts or complete birds. This is production art, not a poster.
characters.faces_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D animated expression head atlas.
Input image 1 is a 3x3 detached parts atlas. Its TOP LEFT CELL is the exact approved neutral head that you must duplicate precisely. Input image 2 is the original full-character style reference.
Create ONE transparent image with a regular 3 column by 3 row invisible grid, showing nine copies of ONLY that SAME detached head. Every head has exactly identical size, silhouette, viewpoint, light, beak shape and location, feather pattern, cheeks and face proportions, centered in its equal cell with ample padding. Only eyelids, eyebrows and mouth state change as specified. Species: lemon-yellow baby cockatiel, warm ivory belly, round orange cheeks, gray hooked beak, gray scaly feet. Preserve soft detailed matte feather shading and the very distinctive long swept yellow crest. The crest is a separate part in the last cell; do not include it on the head.
Read cells left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1: (1) neutral eyes fully open, mouth closed, exact match to input 1 top-left; (2) eyelids partly down, eyes 75% open; (3) eyes half open.
Row 2: (4) sleepy eyelids nearly closed, eyes 25% open; (5) both eyes gently fully closed, natural feather-colored lids and small curved closed-eye line; (6) cheerful smiling closed eyes, a happy gentle face.
Row 3: (7) attentive wide eyes, looking forward, closed beak; (8) normal open eyes and open beak as if singing, same upper-beak anatomy; (9) gently concerned expression with slightly lowered brows, still cute rather than fierce, closed beak.
The head includes cheeks and cranium only. NO torso, feet, neck, wings or tail. Do not include the detached crest or tuft: that is a separate rig part already in input 1. Do not change camera, head tilt, face shape, lighting or proportions between frames. Do not shrink the entire eye or move eyes: eyelids cover the existing eyes. Preserve original eye reflections where the lid does not cover them. Head baseline and scale precisely aligned across every cell to prevent animation flicker. No new colors, no owl face disc, no redesign, no floating symbols, no captions, no numbers, no grid lines, no watermark. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no floor shadow, no color fill or checkerboard. Full head inside every cell.
